context: A grandmother shows her granddaughter an old hina-doll collection
purpose: Teach: 家具/流れる/居る/人形/じっくり/見つめ/やる気/奇跡

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: さくら、押し入れにずっと居る古い人形たちを、今日は出してみたのよ。
lines.en: Sakura, I took out the old dolls that have been staying in the back of the closet.
lines.style: Warm, gentle tone with nostalgic affection from grandmother.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: わあ、すごい!こんな立派なひな人形、うちにあったんだ。
lines.en: Wow, amazing! I had no idea we had such splendid hina dolls.
lines.style: Bright teenage surprise and excited curiosity here.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: もう七十年も経つのに、お顔は当時のまま綺麗でしょう。時間が流れるのを忘れるくらいね。
lines.en: Seventy years have passed, yet their faces stay as beautiful as back then. Enough to make you forget time flowing by.
lines.style: Soft, reflective elderly cadence with quiet wonder.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当だ…こうしてじっくり見つめると、目がすごく優しいね。
lines.en: It's true… when I gaze at them carefully like this, their eyes are so gentle.
lines.style: Quiet teenage awe, slowing down to observe.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 戦争で家具も何もかも焼けたのに、この子たちだけ無事だったの。奇跡みたいでね。
lines.en: The war burned our furniture and everything, but only these dolls survived. It felt like a miracle.
lines.style: Hushed, weighted with old wartime memory.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そんな話を聞くと、私も大事に飾ってあげたい気持ちになってきた。
lines.en: Hearing a story like that, I really want to display them carefully too.
lines.style: Sincere teenage resolve, voice brightening softly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: そう言ってくれると、おばあちゃんもやる気が出るわ。一緒に並べましょうね。
lines.en: Hearing you say that gives grandma some motivation too. Let's arrange them together.
lines.style: Tender grandmotherly warmth with renewed energy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん!よく見てくれてありがとうって、人形たちにも言われてる気がする。
lines.en: Yeah! I feel like the dolls are thanking us for looking at them properly.
lines.style: Cheerful teenage warmth, smiling softly back.
